name: 畢宿星團
scaleRadiusMeaning: catalogue projected radius containing half the members, not a solid surface or tidal boundary
sourceLabel: Cantat-Gaudin et al. (2020), Gaia DR2 / CDS VizieR
licenseNote: CDS/VizieR scientific-use terms; cite the authors and the original A&A catalogue. No blanket Creative Commons licence is asserted for this catalogue.
notes: Data are a selected published membership sample, not a complete cluster census. Missing BP-RP is retained as null, not inferred.
Coordinates remain at Gaia DR2 reference epoch J2015.5. Proper motions are retained for catalogue crossmatching, not epoch propagation.
Distances use inverse high-S/N published parallax. Formal errors do not include Gaia parallax zero-point and spatially correlated systematic effects. No zero-point correction is applied.
Membership probabilities are catalogue assignments, not guarantees; Hyades proba=1 is the value in the compilation.
Observed Gaia G and BP-RP retain foreground extinction. Rendering outside the Solar neighbourhood cannot reconstruct dust extinction along an arbitrary new sightline.
